name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at South stair, east stair. direct left open. 8 steps. The awning stays for the hold.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the awning at South stair. Nobody past the east stair. We hold in 2 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: South stair east stair

line: South stair east stair. Bess keeps the awning for the hold. 3 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
